description:
## 1.0.0-dev.1 (2026-09-26)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* preserve non-forwardable message types ([04792ec](https://github.com/cingxcong/morphe.patches.telegram/commit/04792ec4fcde6d5506fee7e19e78ff26693ef3ad))
* preserve normal paste after disabling rich HTML ([381a623](https://github.com/cingxcong/morphe.patches.telegram/commit/381a623686c575e8a4deb28af4f6dff8b0ed0611))

patches.name: Anti-delete messages
patches.description: Prevents messages deleted by other users from being removed locally.

patches.name: Anti-disappearing media
patches.description: Keeps view-once photos, videos and voice messages viewable indefinitely.

patches.name: Anti-screenshot notification
patches.description: Blocks screenshot notifications from being sent to the other user.

patches.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches.description: Allows opening, viewing, saving and forwarding content from restricted, sensitive, and copyright-restricted channels.

patches.name: Bypass content restrictions
patches.description: Allows saving and forwarding content from restricted channels, chats, and users.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Spoofs certificate fingerprint and SafetyNet results so login works on patched APK.

patches.name: Disable auto-update
patches.description: Disables automatic app update checks, the blocking update screen, and the proxy sponsor channel insertion. On Telegram Plus also disables the Plus-specific updater and update settings flag.

patches.name: Disable channel switching
patches.description: Disables the pull-down gesture that switches to the next unread channel.

patches.name: Download speed boost
patches.description: Increases download chunk size to 1 MB and max concurrent requests to 12.

patches.name: Enable story features
patches.description: Keeps Telegram's story availability and story-entity capability gates enabled.

patches.name: Enable translations
patches.description: Keeps Telegram's automatic and manual message-translation gates enabled.

patches.name: Hide typing indicator
patches.description: Hides your typing indicator from other users in all chats by silencing the controller-level sendTyping dispatcher.

patches.name: High quality stories
patches.description: Always selects Telegram's full-quality story document when a higher-quality alternate is supplied by the server.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages and video ads from all chats and channels. On Telegram Plus also blocks native banner and inline ads.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks Telegram Premium features for the current account.

patches.name: Use normal paste
patches.description: Skips Telegram's Rich HTML paste handler and falls back to the normal paste path.

patches.name: Voice to music
patches.description: Plays voice notes in the full music player with seek bar and background playback.
